DIV8.HEAD: § 25.1397 Color specifications.
DIV8.P: Each position light color must have the applicable International Commission on Illumination chromaticity coordinates as follows:

EXTRACT.FP-2: y is not greater than 0.335; and
x is not greater than y−0.170; and
x is not less than 0.300 and not greater than 0.540;
y is not less than x−0.040; or y0−0.010, whichever is the smaller; and
y is not greater than x + 0.020 nor 0.636−0.400x;
EXTRACT.FP: Where y0 is the y coordinate of the Planckian radiator for the value of x considered.
